The unsigned omo-oss-file110 URL is recorded; the signed URL is not a stable identifier.

All originals were downloaded fresh on 2026-11-19 (HTTP 200). EN57, TLCEN, TLEDS, CL257 and ABZ57 match the SHA-256 recorded by the 2026-11-19 market survey; the other files had no survey hash to compare.

The existing C-family originals in docs/reference/vendor (EN86, ZH86, OP86, ZH57, OP57, LC_StepDriverCAN_V1.1.eds) were not re-downloaded; their working-file SHA-256 values still match docs/reference/SOURCES.json.
The DS-C EDS used for the identity comparison is stored once, in ../lichuan_ds2_canopen/vendor/LC_DSServoCAN_V1.1.eds.
No EDS is published for CL2-57C, CL2-86C, CL257C-ABZ or CL286C-ABZ.
No printed manual revision or firmware version is stated in any source; file-name versions and PDF metadata dates identify documents, not firmware.
The full normative CiA 301/306/402 texts were not obtained.
No vendor software, installer or archive was downloaded or executed; no hardware was contacted.
